episodes.title: Super Heavy static fire, Grok Bot places calls
episodes.dek: Overnight: 33-engine Super Heavy fire for Flight 15, Grok Bot can call on your behalf, quiet labs, Nvidia GTC Berlin.

sections.headline: Monday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Monday, October twenty-sixth. The last twenty-four hours brought a Super Heavy static fire and new Grok Bot capabilities.

sections.headline: Super Heavy 33-engine static fire; Grok Bot makes calls
sections.dek: Full duration fire preparing for Flight 15. Bot can call businesses and summarize.
sections.reaction: No launch overnight, but strong prep and new Bot features.
paragraphs: SpaceX posted a full duration 33-engine static fire for the Super Heavy booster preparing for Flight 15. Elon Musk noted that SpaceX is not buying any neoclouds, calling it pointless, and discussed how debt markets have tightened for companies without independent revenue, while SpaceX closed forty billion in debt for GPUs backed by Starlink and launch revenue. On xAI, Elon announced that Grok Bot can now call someone or a business for you, make a request on your behalf, take notes on the response and send you a note summarizing the conversation. He advised treating Grok Bot as hiring a super competent employee.

sections.headline: Quiet overnight

paragraphs: Anthropic was quiet overnight. No new posts from official accounts in the last twenty-four hours.

sections.headline: Quiet overnight
sections.dek: No new posts from OpenAI accounts.
paragraphs: OpenAI was also quiet. No new announcements or posts overnight.

sections.headline: GTC Berlin highlights: Europe’s AI future
sections.dek: Jensen Huang on AI factories, agents, robotics and healthcare across the continent.
sections.reaction: Europe building its AI future with Nvidia all in.
paragraphs: Nvidia shared highlights from GTC Berlin, where Jensen Huang showed how AI is taking shape across Europe, from AI factories and agents to robotics and healthcare. Europe is building its AI future, and Nvidia is all in.

sections.headline: Quiet on AI fronts

paragraphs: Google was quiet on AI fronts overnight. No major new posts from the official accounts.

sections.dek: Static fire, Bot calls, and Europe AI focus.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Have a good day.
